variants.hypothesis: baseline: byte-identical to what the plugin sends today

variants.name: V1
variants.hypothesis: tool-result filler removed entirely (no user utterance at all)

variants.name: V2
variants.hypothesis: tool-result filler is a machine tag rather than a sentence

variants.name: V4
variants.hypothesis: the <thinking_mode> system prefix the fork never sends (think is always false)

variants.name: V5
variants.hypothesis: collapseAgenticLoops's placeholder replaces the assistant's visible text

variants.name: V6
variants.hypothesis: the agent-task fields the SDK exposes but the plugin never sets

variants.name: V7
variants.hypothesis: a conversationId shared with a real preceding turn instead of a fresh one

variants.name: V8
variants.hypothesis: system prompt kept as its own history turn (turn-1 shape) instead of glued to the user prompt
